jobs.description:
About Ataraxis AI

Ataraxis is a clinical AI research lab working at the intersection of multi-modal AI and precision medicine. Our goal is to make disease predictable. To accomplish this, we develop new AI methods that predict patient outcomes and treatment response, and build clinical tools to assist physicians in selecting the most optimal treatments for their patients.

Our AI research lab discovers and develops methods to recognize patterns and predict outcomes across complex, multi-modal clinical data. This spans our causality (Ataraxis™ Tau), foundation model (Falcon and Kestrel for digital pathology), and survival analysis research.

Our first clinical products, such as Ataraxis™ Breast for breast cancer, already help patients get the most appropriate treatment across the best academic institutions and community clinics worldwide.

At Ataraxis, you will have a unique opportunity to shape not only the future of our company, but also the future of healthcare. You will join an exceptional team at the forefront of clinical AI research and deployment. Our advisors include AI pioneers such as our founding advisor, Yann LeCun, and distinguished oncologists from top cancer research institutions, all united by the mission to redefine precision medicine.

Ataraxis has raised over $24 million in funding, including a $20 million Series A led by top venture capital funds such as Thiel Capital/Founders Fund (OpenAI, SpaceX, Palantir), Obvious Ventures (AMI Labs, Inceptive, Radical Numerics, Recursion), and AIX Ventures (Hugging Face, Perplexity).

We are an company with a flat organizational structure, where every team member is empowered to actively contribute. Leadership roles are earned by those who demonstrate initiative and consistently deliver exceptional results. Strong work ethic and the ability to prioritize ruthlessly are essential.

Responsibilities

-
Serve as the primary contact for physicians, labs, hospitals, patients, and internal teams, responding promptly and professionally to all inquiries via phone, email, or web.

-
Deliver an excellent customer experience by addressing questions about tests, services, billing, and order status with empathy, accuracy, and clear communication.

-
Collaborate with Sales and clients to resolve missing or incomplete data, ensuring smooth ordering process and and timely delivery of test results.

-
Maintain detailed and accurate documentation of all communications, actions, and follow-ups.

-
Research and resolve escalated issues, identify root causes, and communicate outcomes clearly to both customers and internal stakeholders.

-
Stay knowledgeable about Ataraxis oncology tests, including sample requirements, workflows, and documentation needs.

-
Support process improvements and special projects that enhance efficiency, quality, or customer satisfaction.

Qualifications

-
Bachelor’s degree preferred, or an equivalent mix of education and hands-on experience.

-
1-2+ years of client-facing or customer support experience, ideally within diagnostics, biotech, or healthcare.

-
Proficient in Salesforce, Microsoft Office, and general data management or CRM systems.

-
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging for physicians, patients, and internal teams.

-
Strong organizational and time management abilities; able to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

-
Demonstrated problem-solving skills with sound judgment and attention to detail.

-
Works effectively in cross-functional teams, maintaining professionalism and a positive attitude under pressure.

-
Flexible and adaptable to changing business priorities and operational demands.

jobs.description:
Company Overview

LevelUp is a specialist agency providing outsourcing solutions to agencies, software vendors, and website owners. For over seven years, we have successfully collaborated with various companies, delivering valuable technical, operational, and back-office support. We boast a large team of skilled and passionate professionals committed to producing high-quality work for our clients.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated, detail-oriented L1 Hosting Tech Support Agent to join our team. In this critical, frontline, customer-facing role, you will serve as the primary point of contact for clients seeking technical assistance with their hosting environments and WordPress websites.

Leveraging your passion for customer service and solid foundational knowledge of web hosting, you will troubleshoot and resolve a broad spectrum of technical issues via live chat and ticket-based support. Since stellar client experiences are highly valued, you will be expected to multitask efficiently by managing two to three concurrent live chat channels during busy periods while maintaining excellent response times, a high-quality assurance (QA) score, and top-tier Customer Satisfaction (CSAT).

This is a full-time, long-term opportunity embedded in an active, supportive team. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, love solving technical puzzles, and enjoy delivering empathetic, world-class customer service, we would love to have you on board! This fully remote position requires working a fixed mid-shift or night-shift Monday through Friday with no schedule flexibility, observing standard Philippine holidays.

Reference: 2634-323775

Responsibilities

- Provide world-class technical support to hosting customers via live chat (managing 2 concurrent chats, scaling up to 3 during high-volume periods) and ticket-based support via Zendesk.

- Diagnose and resolve common web hosting and WordPress issues, identifying root causes to solve customer inquiries on the first contact whenever possible.

- Assist customers with general WordPress tasks, including troubleshooting issues related to core files, plugins, themes, and configuration errors.

- Answer server-side queries, inspect DNS records, check and update SSL certificates, and troubleshoot website accessibility issues.

- Handle basic database queries and migrations (MySQL) to resolve backend errors and facilitate site movement.

- Utilize basic Linux command-line tools to diagnose, navigate, and troubleshoot server-side issues.

- Meticulously document issues and escalate complex, tier-2 technical problems to senior teams to ensure service continuity.

- Actively meet and exceed key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Customer Satisfaction (CSAT), Average Handling Time (AHT), QA scores, Acceptance Rate, and Average Customer Wait Time.

- Maintain an active, highly responsive online presence via Slack and Zendesk during your entire shift.

Requirements

- 1 to 2 years of solid technical support experience specifically working in a web hosting environment.

- Basic to intermediate knowledge of WordPress, with a demonstrated ability to identify and troubleshoot plugin, theme, and configuration conflicts.

- Proven experience with FTP/SFTP, cPanel, or custom web hosting dashboards.

- Strong understanding of DNS zone files (A records, CNAME, TXT) and SSL setup.

- Basic knowledge of HTTP response status codes (e.g., 500, 404, 403, 502, 504).

- Experience with MySQL databases, including running simple queries or basic site migrations.

- Excellent multitasking capabilities, specifically the capacity to handle 2 to 3 concurrent live chat windows smoothly and accurately.

- Outstanding written and verbal English communication skills, with a conversational, natural flow and minimal grammatical errors.

- A warm, empathetic customer support style that prioritizes active listening, rapport-building, and customer advocacy.

- Practical experience navigating files and running basic diagnostic commands via Linux CLI.

- A bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred (nice-to-have), but equivalent hands-on experience will be highly considered.

More Information

- This is a fully remote position with a standard 40-hour fixed-schedule work week.

- The exact work schedule depends on the client that you are assigned to but is often an afternoon or night schedule and so having flexibility when it comes to schedule is important.

- We have a company culture that focuses on the well-being of its team members, with a good work life balance and respectful work environment.

- Equipment provided

- HMO + 13th month pay and other government-mandated benefits

- Conhecimento do MITRE ATT&CK Framework e capacidade de mapear operações a TTPs relevantes.

jobs.description:
Nosso Modo de Fazer no Time:

Transforme sua carreira com o iFood! Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia referência na América Latina. Por meio de soluções inovadoras, conectamos milhares de restaurantes a milhões de consumidores diariamente com uma média de 100 milhões de pedidos mensais. Além do delivery de comida, também somos Mercado, Farmácia e Pet. Temos também o iFood Pago, nossa Fintech, que engloba o iFood Benefícios, o vale alimentação e refeição do iFood e o próprio iFood Pago, o banco do restaurante. Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma equipe que está sempre à frente com tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante.

Seu Cardápio Diário:

O Data Security Specialist é um profissional técnico responsável pela execução e operação dos controles de segurança de dados corporativos e de produção do iFood. Essa posição atua na interseção entre engenharia de segurança, proteção de dados e execução técnica — implementando controles, investigando incidentes e operando as ferramentas que protegem os ativos de dados do iFood.
O Data Security Specialist executa as operações de segurança de dados, impulsiona a adoção de AI nos fluxos de trabalho diários de segurança e garante que as capacidades de proteção de dados acompanhem o crescimento do iFood. É uma posição de contribuidor individual que exige experiência prática comprovada em engenharia de segurança de dados, com capacidade de atuar tanto no ambiente corporativo quanto no de produção.

Segurança de Dados Corporativos

- Operar e evoluir os controles de DLP (Data Loss Prevention) e ZTNA (Zero Trust Network Access) para endpoints, aplicações em cloud e canais de comunicação — implementando políticas, ajustando regras e executando as prioridades trimestrais.

- Implementar e fazer cumprir políticas de classificação de dados e procedimentos de tratamento para usuários internos e terceiros, garantindo alinhamento com LGPD, GDPR e requisitos regulatórios (BACEN, PCI-DSS, entre outros).

- Configurar e manter os controles de segurança para plataformas corporativas de SaaS: Databricks, Salesforce, Google Workspace, outras plataformas e ferramentas emergentes baseadas em AI — estabelecendo baselines de hardening, controles de acesso e governança de configuração.

- Implementar e fazer cumprir políticas de Document Retention & Disposal — estabelecendo cronogramas de retenção, procedimentos de descarte e mecanismos automatizados de aplicação.

- Executar o programa de insider threat: ajustar regras de behavioral analytics, conduzir cadências de análise de anomalias e coordenar com HR e Legal os casos de risco elevado.

- Gerenciar políticas de device posture e a aplicação de ZTNA, garantindo o acesso de dispositivos em conformidade em todo o ambiente corporativo.

Segurança de Dados de Produção

- Conduzir revisões de segurança da arquitetura de dados de produção: avaliar integrações de dados entre sistemas internos, parceiros e clientes, identificando riscos em APIs, pipelines de ETL e padrões de transferência de arquivos.

- Executar o workstream de Data Security no processo de Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), atuando de forma cross-functional com a equipe de IT Risk e contribuindo continuamente para a melhoria dos security review gates, dos requisitos contratuais de segurança e do monitoramento contínuo dos arranjos de troca de dados com terceiros.

- Promover security-by-design nas equipes de engenharia e dados: incorporar requisitos de proteção de dados aos padrões de desenho de integrações, aos frameworks de governança de APIs e aos controles de data residency.

- Garantir que data residency, criptografia em trânsito e em repouso e modelos de controle de acesso atendam às obrigações regulatórias e contratuais em todos os ambientes de produção.

- Apoiar os programas de conformidade regulatória (LGPD, GDPR, PCI-DSS) relacionados à proteção de dados, atuando como ponto de contato técnico de Data Security para as equipes de Legal, Compliance e Audit.

Adoção de AI e Resultados Mensuráveis

- Impulsionar a adoção de AI nos fluxos de trabalho de Data Security: implementar ferramentas de AI para detecção de padrões anômalos de dados, classificação automatizada de dados, ajuste de políticas de DLP e aceleração de investigações — com melhorias mensuráveis na velocidade de detecção, na redução de falsos positivos e na produtividade dos analistas.

- Contribuir para o workstream de Data Security para AI Security, atuando de forma cross-functional com a equipe de AI Security para melhorar continuamente a governança e definir requisitos de proteção de dados para ferramentas de AI, incluindo casos de uso aprovados, tratamento de dados sensíveis em prompts, controles de acesso, monitoramento e padrões de adoção.

- Acompanhar e reportar os resultados impulsionados por AI: quantificar o tempo economizado, os riscos detectados mais cedo e as melhorias na precisão da classificação atribuíveis às ferramentas de AI.

Colaboração Cross-functional e Resposta a Incidentes

- Atuar como referência técnica de Data Security para as equipes adjacentes: traduzir cenários complexos de riscos relacionados a dados em atualizações claras e contextualizadas pelo impacto no negócio para o Data Security Manager e para os times de segurança.

- Construir e manter o dashboard operacional de Data Security: tendências de risco, taxas de violações de políticas, SLAs de remediação, métricas de adoção de AI e status operacional.

- Participar de iniciativas cross-functional de Data Security: coordenar com Legal, Product, Engineering e IT para equilibrar requisitos de segurança e velocidade do negócio — encontrando o caminho seguro que viabilize a entrega de produtos.

- Gerenciar solicitações de exceção de Data Security: avaliar exceções baseadas em risco às políticas de segurança, documentar recomendações e acompanhar o ciclo de vida das exceções.

- Atuar na resposta a incidentes como referência técnica de Data Security: conduzir a frente de investigação específica de dados durante incidentes de grande impacto, coordenar com o CSIRT e comunicar o impacto do risco relacionado a dados ao Data Security Manager.

Operação Técnica de Programas

- Executar o roadmap técnico de Data Security: traduzir as metas estratégicas em tarefas operacionais, gerenciar o acompanhamento de dependências e reportar o progresso ao Data Security Manager.

- Conduzir iniciativas de Sensitive Data Mapping: executar a descoberta, classificação e catalogação cross-functional de dados nos ambientes corporativos e de produção.

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Specialist
jobs.summary: Talkdesk competes in a market where the quality of execution separates companies that grow efficiently from those that spend more to get the same result.
jobs.description:
Talkdesk competes in a market where the quality of execution separates companies that grow efficiently from those that spend more to get the same result. Marketing Operations is where that execution lives. This role exists to ensure that every dollar of marketing spend, every campaign, every event, and every account-based program translates into pipeline with zero friction. That requires a system built for precision where the right prospect reaches the right person at the right time, consistently and by design.

You sit inside the Marketing team, with close partnerships across Sales and RevOps. The marketers running campaigns, events, and account-based programs are your primary stakeholders. When the system works, their work converts.

In practice, that means owning the full operational surface of marketing technology: administering and continuously improving the tools that make up our GTM stack, building and maintaining the integrations that keep data moving cleanly between systems, designing the orchestrations that automate account and contact engagement, ensuring the enrichment and data integrity standards that make every downstream decision reliable. This is an interdependent system, and this person keeps it running as a coherent, high-performing whole.

What You'll Own

- Account-Based Marketing Orchestration: Serve as the technical owner of our ABM orchestration layer. Translate signals from our intent platform into automated, sequenced actions across our marketing automation platform and CRM, working closely with campaign and field marketing teams to ensure the right programs reach the right accounts at the right moment. Getting this infrastructure right is one of the highest-impact contributions this role makes to the business.

- Marketing Technology Foundation: Own the day-to-day health of our martech systems and the workflows, API calls, integrations, and syncs that connect them to keep prospect data moving accurately through the funnel. When something breaks or underperforms, you diagnose it, fix it, and document the resolution so it does not recur.

- Agentic AI Workflow Engineering: Design and build automated workflows that use AI capabilities to evaluate qualitative signals, such as demo request notes, intent activity, and unstructured form inputs, alongside firmographic data to produce dynamic lead scores and routing decisions. You write the API calls, design the orchestration logic, test against edge cases, and iterate based on conversion outcomes. Experience shipping something to production is the bar.

- Enrichment and Insights: Build and manage the workflows that construct a complete, account-level intelligence profile from the moment a prospect engages. That means aggregating first-party behavioral signals, third-party intent data, firmographic context, and web research into a unified view that captures not just the individual contact but the broader buying committee: who across the account is engaging, with what content, and what their activity suggests about organizational priorities and pain points. That intelligence surfaces in the systems where sales and marketing work, so every follow-up is informed, relevant, and timed to the account's buying journey.

- System Documentation and Enablement: Every workflow you build or modify gets documented: field mapping dictionaries, AI orchestration logic, routing rule change logs. Beyond documentation, you actively invest in making the marketing team more self-sufficient, building self-service reporting and dashboards that allow marketers to check campaign performance, list quality, or lead status independently, and creating resources that allow colleagues to troubleshoot routine tasks and leverage AI tools without filing a request. An empowered marketing team operates with greater speed and confidence, and this role contributes meaningfully to that outcome.

Who You Are

You operate with a high degree of autonomy. You are embedded in the relevant standups, attentive to system performance, and typically ahead of issues before they surface as escalations. Your manager will set context and priorities; the execution is yours to own.

You are invested in the success of the Marketing team. You understand that the campaigns, events, and programs your colleagues execute are only as effective as the systems that support them. Leads from a field event that go unrouted, an ABM sequence that executes against incomplete data, or a high-intent inbound request that experiences significant delay before reaching an SDR all represent measurable pipeline impact. You approach your work with that accountability in mind.

You are technically strong and collaborative by nature. Marketers, Sales and RevOps are close partners. You understand their workflows well enough to anticipate where system gaps will affect their work, and communicate clearly when something is broken, when it is fixed, and why. Strong cross-functional relationships are central to this role.

You see the work through to completion. You build, test, document, and close the loop. When something you own regresses, you identify it first.

What We're Looking For

Required

- 3 to 5 years in B2B SaaS Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, or a systems-adjacent role

- Hands-on marketing automation and CRM administration, including configuring and maintaining MAP-to-CRM syncs

- Demonstrated ability to build and deploy an automated workflow that calls external APIs, whether webhooks, REST APIs, or LLM endpoints, in a production environment

- Native fluency in B2B funnel mechanics: MQL definitions, lifecycle stage transitions, opportunity lifecycles, and attribution models

- Experience coaching or enabling non-technical stakeholders on new tools, AI workflows, or self-service reporting

Strong Signal

- Hands-on administrative experience with intent data platforms, routing engines, and ABM orchestration

- Prior experience building LLM-powered workflows for lead scoring, routing, or qualification

- Comfort reading and writing JSON, working with REST APIs, and debugging integration errors independently

How We'll Measure Success

The through-line across all of it is pipeline efficiency: more of the right prospects converting into pipeline from the programs already running, with less manual intervention and less fallout.

30 days: Full audit of marketing automation-to-CRM field mapping is complete, ownership of inbound routing rules is established, and current ABM workflow patterns are mapped to identify key automation opportunities.

60 days: First agentic AI workflow is deployed to staging or production. At least one major ABM orchestration sequence that previously required manual steps is automated. An initial self-service enablement resource or dashboard is delivered to the marketing team.

90 days and beyond: Lead sync exception rate is at target with a monitoring process that catches regressions before Sales does. ABM orchestration operates as a reliable service layer that campaign and field marketers can brief and trust to execute. Marketing colleagues actively leverage self-service tools and AI workflows independently.

Application Question

Required with your resume (200 words max):

A high-intent prospect submits a demo request but never reaches the assigned SDR in the CRM. Walk us through your exact diagnostic process: which logs you check first, how you trace the break across the marketing automation-to-CRM sync and inbound routing rules, how you validate the fix, and how you would design an agentic step to evaluate the prospect's form submission notes for priority routing.

Eve is redefining legal technology for plaintiff law firms, and we're building the team that will take us there. We help firms handle more cases, recover more for clients, and grow with AI that works across every stage of a case, from intake through resolution. The next generation of great plaintiff firms will be AI-Native, and Eve is how they get there. But what makes Eve different isn't just the product. It's how we build it. Intake is the highest-leverage moment in a plaintiff's firm's relationship with a client — cases get signed or lost here, often before anyone at the firm has opened a file. It's also one of the most technically demanding surfaces we build: every firm's AI voice agent, call scoring, transfer rules, and lead routing gets hand-tuned to that firm's practice areas and intake process, and as more firms come through the door, that build work only becomes more central to how fast and how well they succeed on Eve.

We're hiring a Legal AI Architect to own intake as its own discipline: the technical build, the integration work, and the relationship with every firm going through it, end to end. - You understand intake — call flows, lead qualification, objection handling, and what actually makes a case viable — from real experience with it, whatever form that took.

- You can turn that operational knowledge into a technical build — comfortable configuring and iterating on AI-driven workflows, not just describing how intake should work.

- You document and systematize as you go, so what you know becomes the team's playbook, not just your own.

- You work well across functions — with CSMs who own the client relationship, with integrations engineering, and directly with firms.

This role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, discretion, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow within a fast-paced remote work environment.

As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. This position offers strong growth potential for the right candidate, including opportunities for advancement within the Accounting team or other departments.

We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.

 

Why Join Coalition Technologies?

Coalition Technologies is committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients while providing our team with a fun, thriving, innovative, and growth-focused work environment. We offer:

- 100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade

- Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month

- Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance

- Subsidized gym memberships

- Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members

- International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members

- Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs

- Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards

- Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses

 

Office Assistant Responsibilities

As an Office Assistant, your duties will include:

- Answering phones and emails

- Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records

- Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members

- Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members

- Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports

- Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments

- Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry

- Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year

- Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year

- Facilitating company holiday calendars, time-off calendars, and schedule variation calendars

 

Required Skills and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have:

- Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills

- High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness

- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

- Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks

- Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible

- Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time

- Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers

 

Preferred Skills

- The following experience is preferred but not required:

- Intermediate spreadsheet skills

- Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping

- Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace

- Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations

 

Remote Work Environment

Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world.

 

Growth Opportunity

This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments.

 

Compensation

For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.

About us

GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. For more information, please visit www.gocardless.com and follow us on LinkedIn @GoCardless.

Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.

The role

This role is part of the international Customer Operations group.

In this role, you will be responsible for onboarding and verifying new GoCardless customers, as well as conducting Customer Due Diligence reviews for existing clients, ensuring all processes are both compliant and customer-centric. As a senior member of the Customer Operations team, the KYC Specialist will also act as a primary escalation point for compliance-related issues, both within the team and across other departments.

Working hours:

In the first three months during onboarding - Monday - Friday 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM

After onboarding rotational shift - 4 days on / 4 days off 8:00 AM - 8:00 PM

What excites you

- Reviewing Adverse Media, PEP and Sanctions screening escalations and providing detailed risk assessments and recommendations.

- Opportunities to upskill other team members, proactively share your knowledge with the team and propose process improvements.

- Supporting our Merchants during their onboarding and verification stages.

- Handle internal escalations to relevant teams, such as potential fraud, ML/TF activities, and complex cases.

- Collaborating with various teams, such as AML Financial Crime and Customer Success, to help make sure we’re creating a seamless onboarding experience for customers.

- Conducting due diligence checks on new and existing Merchants in accordance with internal and external requirements.

What excites us

- You are verbally fluent in English and can communicate clearly in writing to support customers via email or over the phone.

- You have previous experience in KYC or AML.

- Detail-oriented with the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

- You care deeply about providing customers with a great experience while keeping calm under pressure.

- You're comfortable working with internal stakeholders at all levels, upholding our core product & compliance requirements with a problem-solving approach.

- Prior experience using tools like Zendesk, Looker, Lexis Nexis is preferred, but not essential.

Base salary range: 18,400 EUR - 27,600 EUR

Headquarters:

Summary
We are seeking an elite, hands-on Senior Security Compliance Consultant (SOC 2 & GRC Specialist) to lead a critical, company-wide SOC 2 Type II audit readiness initiative. In this strategic engagement, you will perform comprehensive gap analyses, assess existing security controls, design robust compliance workflows, and drive cross-functional teams toward audit completion.
The ideal candidate brings a proven track record in GRC frameworks, control mapping, evidence automation, and policy development. Utilizing automated compliance platforms such as Sprinto, you will build repeatable compliance processes, validate technical controls, and ensure a seamless audit experience across the entire organization.
General Information (About the Client)
Our client is a fast-scaling, cloud-native technology platform committed to maintaining enterprise-grade trust, security, and data privacy. To support their rapid commercial growth and enterprise sales pipeline, they are establishing a formal, highly disciplined security governance model.
They operate a modern, cloud-first environment where compliance is treated not as a passive checklist, but as an active, automated operational advantage. By leveraging modern GRC platforms and fostering a security-conscious culture, they provide an empowering environment for compliance experts to drive real architectural and procedural improvements.
Tasks and Deliverables
SOC 2 Readiness & Gap Analysis: Conduct a thorough assessment of existing technical and operational security controls, pinpointing compliance gaps and building an actionable remediation roadmap.
Control Design & Implementation: Author, refine, and operationalize security controls, policies, and procedures aligned with SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria (TSC) and PCI DSS standards.
Automated Evidence Collection: Lead evidence-gathering workflows using automated GRC tooling (Sprinto), ensuring all technical artifacts, access logs, and policy attestations are validated and audit-ready.
PCI DSS Guidance: Provide expert advisory on maintaining PCI DSS alignment alongside SOC 2, ensuring overlapping control requirements are mapped efficiently to reduce operational drag.
Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate with engineering, DevOps, HR, and IT teams to embed compliance workflows into daily operations without slowing down feature execution.
Auditor Interface & Readiness: Serve as the primary liaison during the audit preparation phase, coordinating directly with external auditors to present evidence, resolve findings, and ensure a successful audit cycle.
Required Experience
SOC 2 Mastery: Proven track record of leading end-to-end SOC 2 readiness, gap remediation, and audit preparation initiatives for cloud-native or B2B SaaS companies.
GRC & PCI DSS Acumen: Deep familiarity with Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) frameworks, risk assessment methodologies, and PCI DSS compliance requirements.
Tooling Proficiency (Sprinto): Direct, practical experience leveraging automated compliance and evidence-collection platforms, specifically Sprinto (or equivalent modern platforms like Vanta/Drata).
Policy & Control Mapping: Exceptional capability to author clear, enforceable security policies and translate abstract regulatory requirements into concrete engineering controls.
Cross-Functional Facilitation: Strong stakeholder management skills with a history of driving accountability across distributed engineering, product, and operations teams.

jobs.description:
Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement bienveillant qui avance vite ? 5ème fournisseur français en 10 ans, Octopus Energy est un fournisseur d’énergies renouvelables qui agit comme un véritable fer de lance pour la révolution électro tech.
 
Comment on fait ?  On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer.

On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques.

Tu as envie de rejoindre une entreprise qui grandit vite, avec beaucoup d’autonomie et une façon assez différente de faire les People Ops ?
Bienvenue chez Octopus Energy France.
Chez nous, nous fonctionnons selon un modèle NoHR : les managers sont le premier point de contact people de leurs équipes. Le rôle de l’équipe People Ops est de leur donner le bon cadre, les bons outils, les bonnes informations et les bons réflexes pour qu’ils puissent être autonomes au quotidien.
Dans ce contexte, nous cherchons aujourd’hui quelqu’un de solide en People Ops, capable à la fois de construire et faire évoluer nos façons de travailler, mais aussi de contribuer concrètement au quotidien de l’équipe.
Le poste est organisé autour de deux grands volets, qui représentent chacun environ 50 % du rôle :
du build : projets People, outils, data, automatisation, IA, amélioration de nos process
du run : administration du personnel, paie, support aux managers et aux équipes, contrôle et fiabilisation des données
Cet équilibre n’est évidemment pas figé : selon les actualités, les projets ou les périodes de l’année, tu pourras passer davantage de temps sur l’un ou l’autre.
Ce qu’on cherche surtout, c’est quelqu’un qui aime construire des choses sans perdre le contact avec l’opérationnel.

1. Build : faire évoluer nos People Ops

Une partie importante de ton rôle sera de prendre en main des projets qui permettent à l’équipe People Ops et aux managers de travailler mieux, plus simplement et plus efficacement.

Tu pourras notamment :

-
piloter des projets People de bout en bout, de l’identification du besoin jusqu’à la mise en œuvre

-
simplifier et améliorer nos process

-
construire et faire évoluer notre Help Hub et notre documentation

-
construire des dashboards et des reportings utiles au pilotage : consolider et mieux exploiter les données issues de nos différents outils

-
automatiser certains contrôles, reportings ou tâches répétitives

-
identifier et tester des cas d’usage simples autour de l’IA et de l’automatisation

-
participer à des projets Groupe avec les équipes Octopus basées notamment au Royaume-Uni

-
accompagner les managers dans l’adoption de nouveaux outils ou de nouvelles façons de travailler

On cherche quelqu’un qui aime partir d’un besoin parfois encore un peu flou, le comprendre, le structurer et arriver à une solution concrète.

La data et l’IA sont des outils au service des People Ops et des équipes, pas une fin en soi. Nous ne cherchons donc ni un·e Data Analyst pur, ni un profil tech, mais quelqu’un qui sait s’en servir pour résoudre des problèmes opérationnels.

2. Run : contribuer au quotidien de l’équipe

L’autre moitié du poste consiste à être pleinement partie prenante des People Ops du quotidien.

Selon les besoins de l’équipe, tu pourras intervenir sur :

-
l’administration du personnel : contrats, avenants, mouvements, absences, sorties…

-
la préparation et le contrôle de la paie

-
le contrôle et la cohérence des données entre nos différents outils

-
les questions des managers et des salarié·es

-
le suivi et la résolution de sujets opérationnels

-
le support à l’équipe lors des périodes de forte activité ou lorsqu’un sujet urgent apparaît

L’idée n’est pas de te spécialiser dans l’administration ou la paie. En revanche, tu dois être à l’aise pour mettre les mains dedans, comprendre les sujets et apporter du support à l’équipe lorsque c’est nécessaire.

Chez nous, le run est aussi une source importante pour le build : c’est souvent en étant confronté·e aux irritants du quotidien qu’on identifie ce qu’il faut simplifier, automatiser ou repenser.

- tu as au moins 7 ans d’expérience en People Ops, HR Operations ou sur un rôle généraliste avec une forte dimension opérationnelle

-
tu as un très bon niveau d’anglais à l’oral (minimum B2-C1), indispensable pour travailler avec les équipes Octopus à l’international

-
tu as déjà travaillé dans un environnement start-up / scale-up, où il faut savoir naviguer dans l’ambiguïté, s’adapter vite et avancer sans que tout soit parfaitement cadré

-
tu es à l’aise avec le run People Ops : administration du personnel, paie, contrôle de données, support aux managers et aux équipes

-
tu es à l’aise avec la data et sais l’utiliser pour fiabiliser, analyser et mieux piloter

-
tu as déjà piloté des projets People et/ou outils, de la définition du besoin jusqu’à la mise en œuvre

-
tu es très à l’aise avec Google Sheets / Excel et, plus largement, avec un environnement de travail digital : Google Workspace, Slack, MacBook…

-
tu es pragmatique : tu cherches des solutions simples, utiles et réellement utilisables

-

Anagrafiche e Gestione Sistemi: Mantenimento e aggiornamento costante dei profili dei colleghi sui nostri sistemi gestionali (cambi di ruolo, variazioni contrattuali).

Miglioramento dei Processi & Automazioni: Contributo attivo all’ottimizzazione dei flussi di lavoro, alla creazione/manutenzione di template operativi e all'implementazione di automazioni.

Riservatezza e Cura dei Dati: Garanzia che ogni processo amministrativo e informativo sia gestito con massima cura, precisione e rispetto della riservatezza.

Progetti Amministrativi e Supporto Trasversale: Supporto operativo a progetti speciali o ad altre attività amministrative in base alle esigenze del team.

Ottime capacità comunicative: ottima proprietà di linguaggio sia scritta che orale, fondamentale per interagire con trasparenza con colleghi e stakeholder.

Organizzazione e dettaglio: spiccata attenzione ai dettagli, precisione impeccabile e capacità di organizzare le proprie priorità in modo autonomo.

Serietà e riservatezza: Elevata sensibilità nella gestione di informazioni riservate e dati personali.

Attitudine digitale: familiarità con strumenti digitali, software di gestione del personale o tool di produttività, unita alla capacità di imparare velocemente nuovi sistemi.

Spirito di squadra e proattività: attitudine collaborativa, capacità di anticipare i bisogni e orientamento pratico alla risoluzione dei problemi.

Flessibilità in ambienti dinamici: abilità nel muoversi con disinvoltura in un contesto in rapida crescita, flessibile e privo di burocrazia inutile.

Conoscenza di base di sistemi o procedure paghe (rappresenta un vantaggio apprezzato).

This could not be a better time to join Octopus Energy. We’re taking Tenant Power to the next level. We’ve moved past the early trial phase and are ready to scale things up.
Your mission in this role is to make sure our installations are consistent, super straightforward for installers, and transition smoothly from "ready to go" to fully live and running.
This is a hands-on, field-based role. You won’t be chained to a desk. Instead, you’ll spend plenty of time out on-site working alongside housing associations, third-party installers, suppliers, and our internal teams.
You’ll get to see how things actually work in the real world, help teams get it "right first time," and bring back practical site feedback to help us build better guides, training, and future plans.
Your main goal is keeping things running like clockwork. You’ll support our installers by helping them get a clear grip on:
The Blueprint: The approved Tenant Power design and kit requirements.
The Process: The installation sequence and what we need to see to sign it off.
The Finish Line: What’s required to get the data flowing and officially go live.
Just to keep things clear on who does what:
The Installers: They are independent contractors, usually chosen and hired directly by the housing association or delivery partner.
Octopus: We support the model by setting the technical standards, design rules, and go-live conditions.
The Responsibility: While we are there to guide them, the installers and the partners who hired them are still responsible for the actual site safety, compliance, workmanship, and final certifications.

1. Hands-on on-site support

-
Get stuck in on-site: You’ll work side-by-side with installers during their first setups, live installs, and any troubleshooting runs. You'll help them master the Tenant Power design, meter setups, and what's needed for sign-off.

-
Bridge the gap: You'll collaborate with the OE Homes Delivery team to make sure our guides are actually useful on a busy site. This means making sure instructions for kit setups, battery/inverter wiring, meter placement, and data monitoring are crystal clear.

-
Set teams up for success: Before a single tool is lifted, you'll help make sure the installers truly understand the technical requirements, approved kit lists, and platform guides so there are no surprises midway through.

2. Learning, improving, and scaling

-
Spot what works (and what doesn't): You'll keep an eye out for what makes an install breeze through, as well as the hiccups that cause delays, missing data, or "installed-but-not-yet-live" limbo. You'll use these insights to help us build a smoother, repeatable process.

-
Be the feedback loop: Keep track of common installer questions, repeating issues, or confusing instructions. You’ll feed this real-world feedback straight back to our design, training, and standards teams so we can keep improving.

-
Pick the right battles: Use your on-site knowledge to help prioritize which properties or batches are genuinely ready to go, ensuring we focus on the projects most likely to transition smoothly to live operation.

3. Collaboration and alignment

-
Empower our installers: Since they are independent contractors, your job is to coach them on our standards and design intent. You'll help them confidently deliver high-quality work that matches our blueprint every time.

-
Bring everyone together: You'll act as the connector between housing associations, installers, supply chain, data, and delivery teams, helping to smooth out any friction points in the journey from "installed" to "live."

storage installations and necessary qualifications

Relevant electrical background or qualification, with current BS 7671 / 18th Edition knowledge or competence;

jobs.description:
Chi siamo 
Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte. In Octopus Energy lo facciamo già ogni giorno: rendiamo l'energia più equa e accessibile grazie alla tecnologia.
Presenti in Italia dal 2022, siamo partiti da Ascoli Piceno, dove abbiamo la nostra sede. Oggi abbiamo superato un milione di utenze, con un team di oltre 300 persone tra Ascoli Piceno, Milano e Roma, e più di 250 milioni di euro investiti nel Paese. Una crescita nata da un modo diverso di fare energia: più semplice, più umano, più tecnologico.
 
Come lavoriamo 
Non siamo una compagnia tradizionale e non vogliamo diventarlo. Non ci piacciono la burocrazia, le procedure inutili o i reparti che si scaricano i problemi a vicenda. Quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, vogliamo che trovi persone capaci di ascoltare, prendersi la responsabilità e risolvere.
Questo approccio ci ha portati a essere valutati 4,9/5 su Trustpilot, a vincere la classifica Altroconsumo e a ricevere il premio "Miglior Servizio Clienti" del Corriere della Sera.
 
La tecnologia al servizio di tutti
Qui la tecnologia non è riservata a pochi esperti: è uno strumento che aiuta tutti a lavorare meglio. Non serve essere un mago del computer, ma serve curiosità. Usiamo dati, automazione e intelligenza artificiale per togliere complessità, capire meglio i problemi e dedicare più energia a ciò che conta: migliorare il modo in cui le persone vivono l’energia.
 
Cosa troverai in Octopus
Octopus è un posto per chi vuole portare energia e buon senso. I problemi non arrivano sempre ordinati, le risposte non sono sempre già scritte e spesso c’è da costruire mentre si corre. Ma non sarai solo: lavorerai con persone curiose, generose e concrete, che si aiutano a vicenda e vogliono lasciare le cose meglio di come le hanno trovate. Stiamo già migliorando il modo in cui l’energia funziona per le persone: se vuoi prenderti responsabilità e contribuire a questo cambiamento, qui il tuo lavoro può avere un impatto vero.
 

Il ruolo
Nelle compagnie energetiche tradizionali, quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, spesso passa da un reparto all’altro, ripete le stesse informazioni e aspetta che qualcuno rimetta insieme i pezzi.
In Octopus lavoriamo in modo diverso: usiamo tecnologia, dati e lavoro di squadra per avere le informazioni giuste al momento giusto, ridurre i passaggi inutili e seguire ogni richiesta dall’inizio alla fine.
Sarai il punto di riferimento del cliente. Ascolterai le sue esigenze, userai la tecnologia e gli strumenti a disposizione, collaborerai con il tuo team e accompagnerai il cliente fino alla soluzione.
È un ruolo che unisce relazione, ragionamento e operatività. Servono empatia, giudizio, flessibilità e senso di responsabilità.
Non serve avere già esperienza nel settore energetico. Molte delle persone che oggi lavorano in questo ruolo sono entrate senza conoscerlo: ti daremo formazione, strumenti e supporto per imparare passo dopo passo.
 

⚡ Renderai l’energia più semplice. Aiuterai i clienti a capire bollette, contatori, tariffe e pratiche senza usare parole incomprensibili e senza complicazioni.

💡 Troverai soluzioni concrete. Userai tecnologia, portali e lavoro di squadra per gestire anche i casi più complessi.

📞 Seguirai il cliente dall’inizio alla fine. Niente rimbalzi tra reparti: ti prenderai cura di ogni richiesta fino alla soluzione, reclami inclusi. Lo aiuterai al telefono, via e-mail e su WhatsApp.

🧠 Ragionerai con la tua testa. Niente copioni, niente risposte automatiche: solo conversazioni vere, in cui ascolti, capisci e trovi la risposta più utile.

❤️ Aiuterai ogni cliente come aiuteresti tua nonna. Con chiarezza, gentilezza e voglia di fare un passo in più, perché per noi il servizio clienti si fa così.

🌍 Farai la differenza. Che tu stia aiutando qualcuno a capire meglio la propria bolletta o a scegliere soluzioni energetiche più consapevoli, il tuo lavoro avrà un impatto concreto.

-
Ti piace aiutare le persone, davvero: ti dà soddisfazione capire un’esigenza, sciogliere un dubbio e risolvere un problema.

-
Sai ascoltare e comunicare in modo semplice, diretto e umano, anche quando devi spiegare temi complessi o gestire situazioni delicate.

-
Non devi conoscere già il settore energetico: conta di più la voglia di imparare, capire i problemi e trovare soluzioni.

-
Prendi iniziativa, non ti fermi alla prima difficoltà e ti piace seguire un caso dall’inizio alla fine.

-
Ti riconosci in un modo di lavorare che mette insieme tecnologia, responsabilità personale e lavoro di squadra.

-
In Octopus fare bene il tuo lavoro è naturale: trovi le condizioni giuste per esprimerti al meglio, perché i tuoi obiettivi, quelli dei colleghi e quelli dell’azienda sono perfettamente allineati

-
Lavorerai con persone curiose, brillanti e concrete, che hanno voglia di fare bene e migliorare davvero le cose.

-
Lavorerai per un’azienda che le persone scelgono perché si fidano: abbiamo un servizio clienti valutato 4,9/5 su Trustpilot e premiato da Altroconsumo e dal Corriere della Sera.

-
Farai parte di una realtà concreta, veloce e poco burocratica, dove contano i risultati, il modo in cui li raggiungiamo e l’impatto che creiamo per i clienti.

-
Octopus Energy è un luogo in cui le persone hanno spazio per imparare, prendersi responsabilità e fare davvero la differenza.

-
Equity Options Scheme: in Octopus puoi avere accesso a opzioni su azioni del Gruppo. In pratica, puoi possedere la tua parte di Octopus Energy e partecipare al valore che costruiamo insieme.

-
Focus sul tuo benessere: ti supportiamo con vantaggi concreti come i buoni pasto e un accesso gratuito a sessioni di benessere psicologico.

Cultura: ogni settimana, il venerdì, ci riuniamo tutti per gli aggiornamenti aziendali e un brindisi. Lo chiamiamo Family Dinner.

jobs.description:
Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement bienveillant qui avance vite ? 5ème fournisseur français en 10 ans, Octopus Energy est un fournisseur d’énergies renouvelables qui agit comme un véritable fer de lance pour la révolution électro tech.
 
Comment on fait ?  On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer.

On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques.

Tu as envie de rejoindre une entreprise qui grandit vite, avec beaucoup d’autonomie et une façon assez différente de faire les People Ops ?
Bienvenue chez Octopus Energy France.
Chez nous, nous fonctionnons selon un modèle NoHR : les managers sont le premier point de contact people de leurs équipes. Le rôle de l’équipe People Ops est de leur donner le bon cadre, les bons outils, les bonnes informations et les bons réflexes pour qu’ils puissent être autonomes au quotidien.
Dans ce contexte, nous cherchons aujourd’hui quelqu’un de solide en People Ops, capable à la fois de construire et faire évoluer nos façons de travailler, mais aussi de contribuer concrètement au quotidien de l’équipe.
Le poste est organisé autour de deux grands volets, qui représentent chacun environ 50 % du rôle :
du build : projets People, outils, data, automatisation, IA, amélioration de nos process
du run : administration du personnel, paie, support aux managers et aux équipes, contrôle et fiabilisation des données
Cet équilibre n’est évidemment pas figé : selon les actualités, les projets ou les périodes de l’année, tu pourras passer davantage de temps sur l’un ou l’autre.
Ce qu’on cherche surtout, c’est quelqu’un qui aime construire des choses sans perdre le contact avec l’opérationnel.

1. Build : faire évoluer nos People Ops

Une partie importante de ton rôle sera de prendre en main des projets qui permettent à l’équipe People Ops et aux managers de travailler mieux, plus simplement et plus efficacement.

Tu pourras notamment :

-
piloter des projets People de bout en bout, de l’identification du besoin jusqu’à la mise en œuvre

-
simplifier et améliorer nos process

-
construire et faire évoluer notre Help Hub et notre documentation

-
construire des dashboards et des reportings utiles au pilotage : consolider et mieux exploiter les données issues de nos différents outils

-
automatiser certains contrôles, reportings ou tâches répétitives

-
identifier et tester des cas d’usage simples autour de l’IA et de l’automatisation

-
participer à des projets Groupe avec les équipes Octopus basées notamment au Royaume-Uni

-
accompagner les managers dans l’adoption de nouveaux outils ou de nouvelles façons de travailler

On cherche quelqu’un qui aime partir d’un besoin parfois encore un peu flou, le comprendre, le structurer et arriver à une solution concrète.

La data et l’IA sont des outils au service des People Ops et des équipes, pas une fin en soi. Nous ne cherchons donc ni un·e Data Analyst pur, ni un profil tech, mais quelqu’un qui sait s’en servir pour résoudre des problèmes opérationnels.

2. Run : contribuer au quotidien de l’équipe

L’autre moitié du poste consiste à être pleinement partie prenante des People Ops du quotidien.

Selon les besoins de l’équipe, tu pourras intervenir sur :

-
l’administration du personnel : contrats, avenants, mouvements, absences, sorties…

-
la préparation et le contrôle de la paie

-
le contrôle et la cohérence des données entre nos différents outils

-
les questions des managers et des salarié·es

-
le suivi et la résolution de sujets opérationnels

-
le support à l’équipe lors des périodes de forte activité ou lorsqu’un sujet urgent apparaît

L’idée n’est pas de te spécialiser dans l’administration ou la paie. En revanche, tu dois être à l’aise pour mettre les mains dedans, comprendre les sujets et apporter du support à l’équipe lorsque c’est nécessaire.

Chez nous, le run est aussi une source importante pour le build : c’est souvent en étant confronté·e aux irritants du quotidien qu’on identifie ce qu’il faut simplifier, automatiser ou repenser.

- tu as au moins 7 ans d’expérience en People Ops, HR Operations ou sur un rôle généraliste avec une forte dimension opérationnelle

-
tu as un très bon niveau d’anglais à l’oral (minimum B2-C1), indispensable pour travailler avec les équipes Octopus à l’international

-
tu as déjà travaillé dans un environnement start-up / scale-up, où il faut savoir naviguer dans l’ambiguïté, s’adapter vite et avancer sans que tout soit parfaitement cadré

-
tu es à l’aise avec le run People Ops : administration du personnel, paie, contrôle de données, support aux managers et aux équipes

-
tu es à l’aise avec la data et sais l’utiliser pour fiabiliser, analyser et mieux piloter

-
tu as déjà piloté des projets People et/ou outils, de la définition du besoin jusqu’à la mise en œuvre

-
tu es très à l’aise avec Google Sheets / Excel et, plus largement, avec un environnement de travail digital : Google Workspace, Slack, MacBook…

-
tu es pragmatique : tu cherches des solutions simples, utiles et réellement utilisables

-
tu es autonome, à l’aise dans un environnement qui bouge vite, et capable de prioriser entre projets de fond et sujets opérationnels plus urgents

Pour être transparent, ce poste ne correspondra probablement pas à quelqu’un qui cherche :

-
un poste de Data Analyst / People Analyst pur

-
un rôle uniquement centré sur les projets, sans envie de contribuer au run

-
un poste principalement orienté paie ou administration du personnel

-
un poste purement tech

-
un rôle très stratégique ou de management, éloigné du quotidien des opérations

Nous cherchons quelqu’un de polyvalent et solide en People Ops, qui peut aussi bien passer une matinée à faire avancer un projet outil ou data qu’une après-midi à aider l’équipe sur de la paie, une incohérence de données ou une question manager.

jobs.description:
Welcome to the future of energy

Octopus is a tech-powered energy company. We believe technology has the power to address our greatest challenge, climate change, while also delivering incredible service and customer experience.

We are changing the way people interact with their energy company - by making it approachable, low cost, easy-to-understand, and most importantly, 100% renewable.

Want to work in a soul-destroying customer service call center?
Don’t apply here.
 
We’re a bit different...
You won’t believe it until you actually start working here. We try to explain it during the application and interview process but really, until you’re immersed in our culture, you’ll realize you’ve never worked anywhere like it. 
 
At Octopus you’re not a number. You're a human and we treat you like one. And that’s how we want our customers to feel too. We want you to help our customers - like genuinely help. Like out of the box, what can I do here to make a difference to this customer, help? Crazy huh?
 
You’ll chat to customers over the phone and via email while being given the freedom to help them in a way you too would like to be helped. You’ll take ownership of their needs and find a way, no matter what, to figure things out with them.
 
We treat all of our customers like our grannies, (No offense intended - we really love our grannies) - with patience, kindness and warmth. We could tell you so many stories of the relationships customers have built with us as if we were family. Would you believe they send us poems, artwork, handwritten letters, photos of their family, babies and pets? It’s bonkers and we love it. 
 
We call it the Octopus effect.
It won't take long for those tentacles to wrap around your heart once you join us. Your colleagues will be some of the most amazing people you’ll be lucky enough to call friends. They are the most enthusiastic, determined, curious crew who love being part of disrupting the energy industry but also sharing our mission to humanize the customer service experience. 
 
We don’t lie - it’s not easy.
Learning in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment isn’t for the faint-hearted. Every day you will come across problems not seen before, and you’ll be tasked with bringing about awesome solutions. Expect the unexpected. Ask questions, drive change ,and share your ideas.
 
There’s a lot (and we mean a lot) to learn, and a lot of work to do. Just when you think you know everything there is to know - something changes. We’ll help you build your knowledge and be committed to your development. If you’ve got the attitude to thrive here and want to make a difference - we’ll go that extra mile for you.

- Talk to our customers over the phone or via email, resolving their queries and perhaps engaging with other suppliers too.

- Working in Operations, you’ll be at the heart of everything we do - helping our customers.

- Taking full responsibility for all issues that you come across, you’ll be delivering end to end customer service. Gone are the days of customers getting stuck in a never ending loop of being transferred between departments, you’ll be fully trained in every aspect of the customer experience and be able to help with any problem.

- Every day, you’ll be tasked with bringing about awesome solutions while keeping up with rapid fire change as we grow. Expect the unexpected.

- Fluency in Spanish is strongly preferred

- Prior energy experience isn't required - we'll happily meet you where you're at and teach you what you need to know! We just ask that you have a passion for sustainability and providing world-class customer service!

- Highly motivated and lots of drive to succeed is a must

- MS Office Suite Proficient

- Highly organized

- Energetic

- Quick Learner

- Takes instruction easily and follows through

- Candidates must be available to work a standard schedule of Monday-Friday, 9:00am - 5:30pm.

- Bachelor’s or Associate's Degree

- Excited to help customers - Customers are at the center of everything we do. From the CEO to our Data Scientists, everyone across the business deals with customers. In Operations, we’re at the forefront and the main point of call for all our customers and it will be your main responsibility to go to the ends of the earth to keep our customers impressed and excited about Octopus Energy being their energy supplier.

- Open minded - We’re a rapidly growing company, which means sometimes things go wrong, and we don’t shy away from this. We take everything as a learning curve and expect you to as well, being proactive in spotting weak areas and suggesting solutions and improvements to the customer’s experience.

- Approachable - Everything we do in operations, and across Octopus, is built around teamwork. People in our teams are always there to support and help each other and we expect everyone to be a team player.

- Inclusive - We are looking to continue building our wonderful, inclusive culture full of enthusiastic, unique and diverse people from all backgrounds as we grow and continue to change the industry.

- Dedicated to sustainability - As a renewable energy supplier, those who are a part of our team are also deeply committed to helping in any way they can in their own lives in the fight against climate change and making a positive impact for the future.

- Committed to improvement - Our energy specialists are the main point of call for our customers and their input hugely shapes the customer journey. We are looking for people who will actively looking for ways in which we can improve the customer experience and not be afraid to speak up.

- A strong work ethic - A role in operations is very fast paced and can be challenging at times. We’re looking for people who can deal with challenging situations and who are responsible for their own future by working extremely hard to achieve their goals.

- Innovation-Led Culture: Be part of a company that leads with innovative solutions and challenges traditional industry norms.

- Impactful Work: Your contributions will directly influence our growth and help shape the future of sustainable energy.

- Collaborative Environment: Work in a dynamic, supportive environment that fosters creative thinking and problem-solving.

- Fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance options.

- Paid time off — we know working hard means also being able to recharge as needed, we trust our employees to get the work done and take the time they need. Octopus offers 20 days paid vacation, 8 paid sick days, and discretionary unlimited paid time off.

- 401(k) plan with employer match. Octopus matches 100% of contributions on the first 3% and 50% of contributions from 3-5%.

- Parental leave. Biological, adoptive and foster parents are all eligible. We pay 16 weeks at full pay and then an additional 8 weeks at half pay.

- Pre-tax commuter benefits.

- Equity Options: every Octopus employee owns part of the business. We’re a team, working together towards huge goals. Every person is crucial to our success, you should be rewarded as such.

- Wondering what the salary for this role is? Just ask us! When on a call with one of our recruiters it's something we always cover as we genuinely want to match your experience with the correct salary. The reason why we don't advertise is because we honestly have a degree of flexibility and would never want salary to be a reason why someone doesn't apply to Octopus - what's more important to us is finding the right octofit!

jobs.title: Credit Specialist
jobs.summary: Chi siamo Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte.
jobs.description:
Chi siamo 
Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte. In Octopus Energy lo facciamo già ogni giorno: rendiamo l'energia più equa e accessibile grazie alla tecnologia.
Presenti in Italia dal 2022, siamo partiti da Ascoli Piceno, dove abbiamo la nostra sede. Oggi abbiamo superato un milione di utenze, con un team di oltre 300 persone tra Ascoli Piceno, Milano e Roma, e più di 250 milioni di euro investiti nel Paese. Una crescita nata da un modo diverso di fare energia: più semplice, più umano, più tecnologico.
 
Come lavoriamo 
Non siamo una compagnia tradizionale e non vogliamo diventarlo. Non ci piacciono la burocrazia, le procedure inutili o i reparti che si scaricano i problemi a vicenda. Quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, vogliamo che trovi persone capaci di ascoltare, prendersi la responsabilità e risolvere.
Questo approccio ci ha portati a essere valutati 4,9/5 su Trustpilot, a vincere la classifica Altroconsumo e a ricevere il premio "Miglior Servizio Clienti" del Corriere della Sera.
 
La tecnologia al servizio di tutti
Qui la tecnologia non è riservata a pochi esperti: è uno strumento che aiuta tutti a lavorare meglio. Non serve essere un mago del computer, ma serve curiosità. Usiamo dati, automazione e intelligenza artificiale per togliere complessità, capire meglio i problemi e dedicare più energia a ciò che conta: migliorare il modo in cui le persone vivono l’energia.
 
Cosa troverai in Octopus
Octopus è un posto per chi vuole portare energia e buon senso. I problemi non arrivano sempre ordinati, le risposte non sono sempre già scritte e spesso c’è da costruire mentre si corre. Ma non sarai solo: lavorerai con persone curiose, generose e concrete, che si aiutano a vicenda e vogliono lasciare le cose meglio di come le hanno trovate. Stiamo già migliorando il modo in cui l’energia funziona per le persone: se vuoi prenderti responsabilità e contribuire a questo cambiamento, qui il tuo lavoro può avere un impatto vero.
 

Sei una persona che sa gestire situazioni delicate con empatia e precisione? Stiamo cercando un Credit Specialist per aiutarci a supportare i nostri clienti e trovare il giusto equilibrio nei pagamenti. 

- Interagire con i clienti per recupero crediti.

- Analizzare la situazione finanziaria dei clienti e proporre piani di pagamento personalizzati e sostenibili.

- Supportare i clienti che si trovano in difficoltà economiche, identificando soluzioni tramite strumenti dedicati.

- Usare l’iniziativa per trovare la soluzione migliore, concordando piani di rimborso adeguati.

- Collaborare con i team interni e gli enti esterni (es. Agenzie di recupero crediti) per una gestione efficace del credito.

- Gestire comunicazioni e richieste tramite sistemi dedicati e garantire un servizio rapido ed efficiente.

- Monitorare le normative di settore e applicare le best practices per una gestione conforme e trasparente.

- Esperienza pregressa in un ruolo simile, preferibilmente nel settore energetico, finanziario o assicurativo.

- Capacità di analisi e attenzione ai dettagli, con un approccio orientato alla soluzione.

- Ottime doti comunicative e relazionali per interagire con clienti e colleghi.

- Attitudine al lavoro in un ambiente dinamico, con capacità di gestire priorità e scadenze.

- Conoscenza delle normative relative al credito e capacità di mantenersi aggiornato sulle evoluzioni del settore.

- Octopus Energy è un luogo in cui le persone hanno spazio per imparare, prendersi responsabilità e fare davvero la differenza. Lavoriamo con autonomia e fiducia, crediamo che l’impegno vada riconosciuto con benefici che contano davvero per chi lavora con noi.

- Equity Options Scheme - puoi possedere la tua parte dell'azienda, opzioni di azioni nell'intero Octopus Energy Group: tutti lavoriamo insieme per il successo.

- Focus sul tuo benessere - ti supportiamo con vantaggi concreti come i buoni pasto e un accesso gratuito a sessioni di benessere psicologico.

- Cultura dell'ufficio - ogni settimana, il venerdì, ci riuniamo tutti (questo avviene anche virtualmente) per gli aggiornamenti aziendali e un brindisi - lo chiamiamo Family Dinner.

- A genuine passion for going above and beyond for customers and a strong passion for Electric Vehicles, sustainability and/or the automotive industry

jobs.description:
宇宙に「緑」の大穴をあけるために、力を貸してください！ 世界中で再生可能エネルギー革命を推進するミッションを実現するため、より多くの人の協力が必要なのです。

＜ご応募の際は日本語の職務経歴書をご提出ください＞

年次有給休暇23日／東京ガスと英国オクトパスエナジーの合弁会社

わたしたちは「グリーンな電力」をお手頃価格で提供地球に優しいグリーンな電力を手頃な価格で提供する会社です。
近年世界中で注目の「再生可能エネルギー」を日本にも普及させるため、2021年に東京ガスと電力会社オクトパスエナジーが共同出資して誕生しました。

＜わたしたちはこういう会社です＞
・出社と同時に自分の個性を包み隠さなくてはならないような職場ではなく、本来の自分でいられるような会社にしたい。なぜならその人物こそが我々が採用した人であり、ありのままの自分で同僚とやりとりしたり、お客様の応対をしてほしいから。その人の本質を尊重し、ありのままの自分で居られて、自ら創造性を高めて仕事に大いに貢献してもらえるような会社でありたい。そのためにも、社員がインスパイアされモチベーションを高められリラックスできる空間と合わせて、世界中の方々をお迎えする空間作りを行っている。
・オクトパスの原理は、昔の建築の石垣の原理。つまり、２つと無いユニークな形の自然石同士の合わせの良さで強度を持たせて、何千年も持ち堪えることができる仕組みを大事にしている。だからこそありのままの自分を出してほしい。
・自由と責任は比例する。みなさんには自由を持って働いてほしい。ソファに体をうずめて脚を投げ出した格好で仕事をしても良いし、好きな音楽を聴きながらでもいいし、服装も完全自由。休暇の申請も妥当なタイミングで良い。出勤退勤の打刻も必要無い。就業規則は最小限の内容。ただし自由には責任が伴う。自由と適切なプレッシャーを同時に味わいながら、常に昨日の自分よりも成長してほしいし邁進してほしい。
・負荷をかけるというと、大企業では「苦手なことをさせる」場合が多いが、オクトパスでは皆が得意分野に取り組んで、オリジナリティを活かす。それこそが組織の強靭化につながる。なので、ITがやりたいならITを、営業なら営業、企画なら企画、好きなことで最大限あなたの力を活かしてほしい。そしていま私たちは、カスタマーサービスがやりたい人を探している。
・ミスは表彰する。ミスが起きたとき、ミスをミスと認めることが肝要。そしてそれを責めず、寛容さをもって受け入れる。時には表彰して茶化す(笑)。皆が皆理由があってここにいるのだから、皆で支え合うのが当たり前。

- 週休二日制です。
- オペレーション部門にて、日本のお客様をサポートするすべての業務の中心となっていただきます。
- お客様が直面するすべての問題に全責任を持ち、エンド・ツー・エンドのカスタマーサービスを提供します。
- もう、お客様が部署間をたらい回しにされるようなことはありません。
- 顧客体験のあらゆる側面について完全に訓練され、業界全体のトレーニングが提供されます。
- お客様からの問い合わせに全責任を持ち、適切な解決策を提供できるようになることが期待されます。
- 予想外のことも想定してください。
- エネルギーの経験は必要ありません。オクトパスではこれまでとは異なるやり方をしますので、必ずしも役立つとは限りません！主体性のある方を求めています。柔軟でダイナミックな機会を探している方なら学歴・年齢不問。新卒の方でも、子育て中の方でも、フレキシブルでダイナミックなお仕事をお探しの方なら大歓迎です。

- 日本のお客様へ電話サポートができるレベルの日本語力 - わたしたちは日本のお客様に日本語でサポートとサービスを提供しています。トレーニングも日本語で行われます。そのため日本語の読み書き、および会話が今現在すでに流暢な方でなければ、日本でのエナジースペシャリストの仕事は難しいです。
- カスタマーサポートへの情熱 - お客様は私たちのすべての活動の中心です。オクトパスエナジーでは、CEOからデータ・サイエンティストに至るまで、社員全員がお客様と接しています。オクトパスエナジーが、エネルギーサプライヤーとしてお客様に感動と興奮を与え続けられるために、地の果てまで赴くことがあなたの主な責任となります。
- オープンマインド - わたしたちは急成長中の企業であり、時にはうまくいかないこともあります。何事も学習曲線と捉え、積極的に弱点を発見し、解決策を提案し、顧客体験を改善することが期待されます。
- 親しみやすい - オペレーション部門はもちろん、オクトパスではチームワークを大切にしています。オクトパスでは、チームの全員が常にお互いをサポートし、助け合い、チームプレーヤーであることが期待されます。
- インクルーシブ（排他的じゃない） - オクトパスが成長し、業界を変革し続けるために、わたしたちの組織はあらゆるバックグラウンドを持つ、熱意と個性にあふれた多様な人材で構成されています。そして素晴らしいインクルーシブな企業文化を築き続けたいと考えています。排他的な考えをしがちな人には不向きな仕事です。
- 持続可能性への献身 - 再生可能エネルギーを供給する立場として、気候変動との闘いにおいて自分自身の生活の中でできる限りの支援をし、未来に良い影響を与えることに深くコミットしていただきます。
- 改善へのコミットメント - 今回募集するエナジースペシャリストという仕事はお客様との主な窓口であり、エナジー・スペシャリストの意見や提案は顧客体験に大きな影響を与えています。ですので、顧客体験を改善する方法を積極的に探し、発言することを恐れない人材を求めています。
- 仕事に対する強い倫理観 - オペレーションの仕事は非常にペースが速く、時には困難なこともあります。言い訳したくなる事もあるでしょう。しかしわたしたちは、困難な状況に対処して目標達成のために懸命に努力することで、自分の将来に責任を持てる人材を求めています。取得した経験やスキルや仲間からの信頼は、すべてあなた個人の財産です。

- 勤務地：東京都港区六本木１−４−５アークヒルズサウスタワー１８階
- 交通：東京メトロ南北線「六本木一丁目駅」より徒歩１分
- 勤務時間：フレックスタイム制（標準労働7.5時間）＊9:00-17:00は電話対応がある時間帯なのでこの時間帯に従事できることを期待されます。残業は月平均10〜20時間
- 年間休日：121日
- 週休2日制。六本木のオフィスへ出勤していただきます。
- 年末年始休暇
- 年次有給休暇は入社初日から23日間付与します
- 産休・育休
- 介護休暇
- 慶弔休暇
- 上司判断による追加の有給休暇もあります

Join us as Social Media Manager Italy to define and execute Qonto's social media strategy across Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube for the Italian market. You'll drive brand awareness, engagement, and customer acquisition through culturally resonant content, influencer collaborations, and data-driven campaigns. You will report to Marta Rifà Llimós, Head of Southern Europe Marketing.
➡️ What you'll do
Own the social strategy for Italy: Define the channel mix, content types (entertainment, product, educational, corporate), and calendar across IG, LinkedIn, and YouTube — with full autonomy.
Build and run the content calendar: Coordinate the monthly publishing plan across Design, Press, Events, PMM, Community, and external agencies. You ensure on-time delivery and strategic coherence.
Create content hands-on: Shoot and edit video/photo content using CapCut, Edits, Figma, or similar tools. Be comfortable on camera — you bring Qonto's Italian brand to life through owned content.
Run paid social campaigns: Manage LinkedIn campaigns directly, coordinate Instagram paid with our Italian agency, and support YouTube Ads with the media team.
Track performance and evolve strategy: Extract KPIs, draw conclusions, and systematically apply learnings. You use data to evolve your approach, not just report on it.
➡️ What we're looking for
3 years as the in-house social media owner for an Italian brand — not agency-side. You've designed and executed the full channel strategy across IG, LinkedIn, and YouTube solo, without an account manager or team below you. B2B or scale-up experience strongly preferred
Italian copywriting excellence: sharp, error-free, culturally resonant. You localise, not translate. Perfect written and oral Italian and English.
Data fluency: You work with Sprout, Google Analytics, Looker Studio (or equivalents) and you can walk through a campaign's performance metric by metric and tell me what you changed as a result — not just that results were positive
Influencer management: You've run creator campaigns end-to-end — sourcing, briefing, negotiation, performance tracking. You've owned the full cycle.
Paid social experience: You've managed LinkedIn campaigns and can brief an agency on Instagram paid with clear objectives and creative direction.
➡️ What we can offer you
Full ownership of a market: You define Italy's social strategy and you execute it. No committee approvals — you own the output and the results.
A growing content playground: Podcast, influencer collaborations, events coverage, video production — the formats are expanding and you'll shape what comes next.
Cross-functional collaboration across Southern Europe: You'll work daily with Design, Press, Events, PMM, Community, and Qonto's global social media team. Marta's team covers Italy, Spain, and Portugal — three markets, shared learnings.
AI-first environment: Daily experimentation with AI tools is expected. You'll have access to the best tools on the market to evolve your craft.
➡️ Your future manager
Your manager will be Marta Rifà Llimós, Head of Marketing Southern Europe, based in Barcelona.
Her path? 10+ years in digital marketing across Southern European markets. Marta spent 5+ years at Engel & Völkers growing from Digital Marketing Assistant to Marketing Manager Iberia, then led EU performance and cross-channel marketing at Birchbox. She joined Qonto in 2022 as Marketing Lead Spain, built the market from the ground up, and was promoted to Head of Marketing Southern Europe in 2025 — now leading Italy, Spain, and Portugal.
What does she bring to the team? A hands-on, data-driven leadership style with deep multi-market experience. She's built marketing operations from scratch and knows what it takes to grow a market. She runs a flat team where ideas are welcomed and ownership is expected.
